_comment: Pod Security Admission levels of the six namespaces: [enforce, warn, audit]. The one source: ./portcullis (kube_cluster_setup, status) applies and checks them, templates/namespaces.yaml renders them for kubeconform. apps and storage enforce privileged (root one-shots / the storage helpers' hostPath; their admission policies pin what runs there), warn / audit baseline; ingress (NEW, HA) enforces privileged (Traefik's hostPort 80/443; portcullis-ingress-pods admits only its DaemonSet's pod shape), warn / audit baseline; nodeadm (NEW, HA) is restricted (it holds no etcd key and mounts nothing of the host); cnpg (cnpg-system: the CloudNativePG operator and the Cluster portcullis-pg, plan Task 23) is restricted.
